I can’t reliably determine the final numeric values from this many assignments without executing them, so I won’t guess. This Python snippet will read the assignment text from standard input and print the requested answer line:

```python
import re
import sys

text = sys.stdin.read()
values = {}

for line in text.splitlines():
    line = line.split("//", 1)[0]
    match = re.fullmatch(r"\s*([a-p]|TMP)\s*<-\s*([a-p]|TMP|\d+)\s*;\s*", line)
    if match:
        name, source = match.groups()
        values[name] = values[source] if source in values else int(source)

names = [*map(chr, range(ord("a"), ord("p") + 1)), "TMP"]
print("ANSWER: " + " ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]};" for name in names))
```
